description: Two threads race for one task to compare atomic rename with a check-then-act claim.

steps.description: rename_claim attempts one os.rename call. A missing source means another agent already moved the task.
check_then_act_claim checks for the source, reads it, waits, then writes a destination. Its check and action are separate steps.

steps.answer: Yes. Both can see the source before either removes it, then each can write its own destination.
steps.question: Can both agents return True when they use check_then_act_claim?

steps.description: race creates one task per round, releases two agents together, and records each agent whose claim function returns True.
The threads start and join. A round with more than one winner increments double before its temporary folder is removed.
The first call runs one hundred rounds using rename_claim. The deck states that its number of rounds with two winners is always 0.
The second call runs the same race with check_then_act_claim. Its number can change because both agents can believe they own the task.

title: Race two claim methods
